name: Hive Metastore
description: Standalone metadata catalog service that tracks table schemas and locations for Hive, Spark and Trino.

envVars.description: Hive service to run in this container
Password for the metastore's backing Postgres database

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      SERVICE_OPTS: "-Djavax.jdo.option.ConnectionURL=jdbc:postgresql://{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/metastore -Djavax.jdo.option.ConnectionDriverName=org.postgresql.Driver -Djavax.jdo.option.ConnectionUserName=hive -Djavax.jdo.option.ConnectionPassword={{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}"
      SERVICE_NAME: {{env.SERVICE_NAME}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/warehouse:/opt/hive/data/warehouse
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: hive
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: metastore
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
